generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.description: Please try again in a few seconds.

notFound.title: No party here
notFound.description: The page you are looking for does not exist.

discover.title: The night map
discover.description: 3D night map with venues, events and who is there, live.

tonight.title: Tonight
tonight.description: Here Now and Going Tonight, with the swipe stack and real-time matches.

themes.title: Themes
themes.description: Change the look of the whole app instantly. All of them meet AA contrast.

neon-noir.name: Neon Noir
neon-noir.description: Deep black, violet and cyan with a soft glow.

cyberpunk.name: Cyberpunk
cyberpunk.description: Magenta, acid yellow and cyan. Made for techno.

velvet.name: Velvet
velvet.description: Burgundy, warm black and gold. Elegant and unhurried.

sunset.name: Sunset
sunset.description: Oranges and pinks over night blue. Terraces and summer.

reduceMotion.label: Reduce motion
reduceMotion.systemActive: Your system already asks for reduced motion: it is always respected.
reduceMotion.themeActive: The Mono theme always uses minimal motion.

designKit.title: Component kit
designKit.description: Base components painted with the active theme. Only visible while test tools are enabled.

sheet.title: {{name}}
sheet.body: Spring-physics sheet. Drag it down or use the button to close it.

live.title: See where the vibe is, right now
live.body: People, average age and atmosphere live in venues and events near you.

connect.title: Meet people before and during the night
connect.body: “Going Tonight” and “Here Now”: match with whoever will be where you are.

safe.title: Your night, safe and connected
safe.body: Verified adults only, instant block and report, and safety tools.

birthdate.title: What is your date of birth?
birthdate.body: We use it to show your age and for statistics. Nobody will see your exact date.
birthdate.label: Date of birth

errors.future: The date cannot be in the future.

notEligible.title: We can't create your account
notEligible.body: Nightlife Connect is only available to adults. We have not stored any data.

legal.title: Before you start
legal.body: Read the documents and tick each box. None is pre-ticked.

checks.terms: I accept the Terms and Conditions and the Community Guidelines.
checks.privacy: I have read the Privacy Policy.

legalDeclined.title: We can't continue without your acceptance
legalDeclined.body: To use the app you need to accept the Terms and Guidelines and read the Privacy Policy. No account has been created.

phone.title: Your phone
phone.body: We'll send you a code by SMS. Only one account per phone number.
phone.resendIn: You can request another in {{seconds}} s
phone.emailHint: To send you your signed documents. We'll send a link to verify it.

errors.rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Wait a few minutes.
errors.blocked: We can't complete sign-up with this number.
errors.expired: The code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code later.

consents.title: Your privacy, your rules
consents.body: Nothing is switched on. Decide what you allow; you can change it any time in Profile → Consents.

orientation.title: Orientation and preferences
orientation.description: Who you want to meet and in which age range, to show you compatible people.
orientation.without: You won't see compatible profiles or get matches.

precise_location.title: Precise location
precise_location.description: For the map, what's nearby and check-ins. We never show your exact location to anyone.
precise_location.without: You explore by choosing a city and can't check in.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: Aggregated usage metrics to improve the app. No session recording.
analytics.without: We won't measure how you use the app.

consents.cityRequired: Choose a city or turn on location.
consents.locationBlocked: Your browser blocked location. Choose a city or enable it in your browser settings.

orientationSheet.title: Explicit consent
orientationSheet.body: Your orientation and preferences are specially protected data. We only use them to match you, never for advertising, and you can withdraw consent at any time.
orientationSheet.check: I give my explicit consent to the processing of my orientation and preferences in order to be shown compatible people.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.body: This is how age-verified people will see you.
profile.name: Name
profile.nameError: Enter a name of 2 to 30 characters.
profile.photosHint: 2 to 5. The first one is your main photo. Uploaded without location data.

photoErrors.unsupported_type: Use a JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF photo.
photoErrors.too_large: The photo is too large (15 MB max).

profile.anthemHint: You'll be able to pick your song by connecting Spotify from your profile. Coming soon.

preferences.title: Who do you want to meet?
preferences.body: Only used to match you. You can change it any time.

theme.title: Choose your style
theme.body: You can change it any time in Profile → Themes.

layered.title: Basic data protection information
layered.rightsValue: Access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability.

phone.purpose: Create and protect your account (access and anti-fraud).

profile.purpose: Show your profile to other verified adults.

consents.purpose: The optional processing you choose below.
consents.basis: Your consent, which you can withdraw at any time.

center.title: Verification centre
center.description: We check what's needed without knowing who you are: we only store yes or no.
center.neverStored: We never store ID numbers, document images, selfies, videos or face data.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: Verified when you created your account.

age.title: Age (18+)
age.description: Required to view profiles, like, chat, mark “Going” and create events.

photo.title: Verified photo
photo.description: ✓ badge, priority in the swipe and appearing in “Verified only”.

identity.title: Verified identity
identity.description: Confirms you are who you say. We never show your real name or ID.

aiNotice.title: Artificial intelligence notice
aiNotice.body: This step uses an AI system that can make mistakes. If you disagree with the result, a person will review it. If you prefer, use another method.

age.title: Verify you are an adult
age.body: Yoti, a specialised provider, does it. We only receive whether you are an adult or not.
age.how1: Facial age estimation with liveness detection: usually no document needed.
age.how2: If it's inconclusive, you can use your ID with a selfie or a Digital ID in the same flow.
age.unavailable: Verification isn't available right now. Please try later.

photo.title: Verified photo
photo.body: Take a live selfie with a gesture and we compare it with your photos. Images are deleted at the end and we keep no face data.
photo.consent: I give my explicit consent to compare a live selfie with my profile photos (GDPR art. 9.2.a).

identity.title: Verified identity
identity.body: ID and selfie through Yoti. We only store that your identity is verified: never your real name, ID number or date of birth.
identity.consent: I give my explicit consent to verify my identity with Yoti.

sandbox.title: Provider simulator
sandbox.body: Test mode (verification_mode = sandbox): choose what the provider would return. This simulates its signed webhook.
sandbox.liveMode: The real provider is not connected yet (arrives in Block 6).
sandbox.documentStep: The provider now asks for an ID with a selfie.

result.manual_review: A person will review your verification.
result.failed: We couldn't verify you. You can request human review or try again.
result.pending: Your verification is still in progress.

gate.title: Verify your age
gate.body: To {{action}} we need to confirm you're an adult. It's free and we only store yes or no.
gate.pending: Your verification is in progress. We'll let you know when it's done.
gate.review: A person is reviewing your verification.

consentSettings.title: Consents
consentSettings.description: You can withdraw any consent as easily as you gave it.

profileMenu.resetOnboardingHint: Back to the welcome screens (testing only)

trafficLight.title: Traffic light
trafficLight.greenHint: You appear in swipes and are open to flirting.
trafficLight.yellowHint: You appear with the “Friendship only” label.
trafficLight.redHint: You don't appear in swipes. You can still use the map and your chats.

discreet.title: Discreet mode
discreet.body: You count in the statistics but don't appear in the “Going” or “Here Now” lists.

tonightPreview.verifiedReady: Age verified: the swipe arrives in Block 3.

places.mapLabel: Night map of venues and events
places.noResults: Nothing matches these filters. Try removing some.
places.privacyNote: For privacy, with fewer than 5 people we show nothing else.

going.outsideWindow: “Going Tonight” can be marked from 18:00 until 06:00.
going.testNote: Test mode: allowed outside the time window.

checkIn.invisible: Invisible check-in until you verify your age

errors.too_far: You need to be within 150 m of the place to check in.
errors.no_location: We can't tell where you are. Turn on location to check in.

lostFound.title: Lost & found
lostFound.empty: No posts in the last 48 hours.

errors.no_recent_check_in: You need to have checked in here in the last 12 hours.

event.title: Event
event.safety: Unconfirmed event: go with friends, meet in busy places and report anything odd.

errors.notAvailable: This event no longer needs confirmations.

event.reported: Thanks. A person will review it.

noCheckIn.title: You haven't checked in yet
noCheckIn.body: Check in somewhere to see who's with you first.

noGoing.title: Where are you going tonight?
noGoing.body: Mark “Going Tonight” on a place to meet who else is going.

matching.deckHint: Swipe right to like and left to pass, or use the arrow keys.

empty.title: You've seen everyone here
empty.body: These nearby places have people right now:

limit.title: You've used today's likes
limit.body: You get 5 free likes again tomorrow. Viewing profiles, chatting and verifying are always free.

icebreakers.tonight: What time are you getting to {{place}}?

generic.plan: What's your perfect plan for tonight?
generic.song: If your song comes on: dance floor or bar?
generic.spot: What's your favourite spot around here?

empty.title: No matches yet
empty.body: Go to Tonight and swipe. When you match, you can talk here.

safety.unavailable: This profile is no longer available

report.title: Report {{name}}
report.body: Tell us what happened. {{name}} won't know it was you.
report.humanReview: A person will review the report. If there is serious risk, we alert the authorities.

block.title: Block {{name}}?
block.body: You'll stop seeing each other instantly, also at venues, and the match is deleted.

unmatch.title: Delete the match with {{name}}?
unmatch.body: It's deleted for both of you, with the conversation.

create.title: Create event
create.body: Up to {{max}} events a day, public places only.
create.name: Event name
create.rules: It will be published as “Unconfirmed” until {{count}} different people confirm it exists within {{hours}} hours. Otherwise it is deleted.
create.publicPlace: I confirm it is a public, open place.

errors.not_verified: Verify your age to create events.
errors.duplicate: There's already a similar event at that place and time.
errors.not_public: Events can only be created in public places.
